The [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] [[Thief/Legends|thief]] [[Kea Ra-Lan]] owned a luxurious '''retreat''' in the [[Dal forests]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kinyen/Legends|Kinyen]]. During the reign of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], the [[Kinyen planetary constabulary]] raided the retreat in a search for Ra-Lan.<ref name="SWAJ10:WBC">{{JournalCite|10|Wanted by Cracken (Star Wars Adventure Journal)}}</ref>
